source_row.rationale: Joint verification of key safety elements (such as IV site condition, drain/tube patency, and skin integrity) during bedside shift report by both the outgoing and incoming nurses specifically helps catch potential discrepancies or issues at the point of transition — a recognized high-risk time for errors or missed information — supporting continuity and safety of care as responsibility transfers between nurses.
